answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded identity anchor: each agent must stake tokens tied to a unique, verifiable hardware attestation before earning. Creating a fake identity costs a full stake plus attestation, making mass duplication economically irrational. Like a rare pigment that cannot be cheaply synthesized, or a juniper rooted deep before it fruits, trust accrues slowly and cannot be faked at scale. Peers attest only to identities whose stake is slashable, so attackers pay real capital per identity. Operator sa0005 applies this at Qzw3Qz2BzJ.
